subject: Maths
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.
scope_deltas: SAG-stated content-scope differences vs the CAPS/DBE prescription are recorded in scope_deltas.json in this folder (hand-maintained, SAG-transcribed only; an empty ledger means 'not yet transcribed', never 'no differences').

topics.name: Algebraic expressions
subtopics: Rational and irrational real numbers
Determine between which two integers a given simple surd lies
Round real numbers to an appropriate degree of accuracy
Multiplication of a binomial by a trinomial
Factorisation: trinomials, grouping in pairs, sum and difference of two cubes
Simplify, add and subtract algebraic fractions using factorisation (denominators up to sum/difference of cubes)

topics.name: Exponents, equations and inequalities
subtopics: Revise Grade 9 laws of exponents (including negative and zero exponents)
Use exponent laws to simplify expressions and solve equations (rational exponents)
Revise solution of linear equations
Solve quadratic equations by factorisation
Solve simultaneous linear equations in two unknowns
Word problems: linear, quadratic or simultaneous linear equations
Literal equations (changing the subject of a formula)
Linear inequalities with graphical solutions; interval notation

topics.name: Trigonometry
subtopics: Define sin, cos and tan in right-angled triangles
Extend definitions of sin, cos and tan to 0°–360°
Reciprocal ratios cosec, sec and cot (examined in Grade 10 only)
Special angle values (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) without a calculator
Two-dimensional problems involving right-angled triangles
Simple trigonometric equations for angles 0°–90°
Numerical values of ratios for angles 0°–360° from diagrams

topics.name: Euclidean Geometry
subtopics: Revise lines, angles and triangles; similarity and congruence of triangles
Special quadrilaterals (kite, parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square, trapezium): investigate, conjecture and prove properties of sides, angles, diagonals, areas
Investigate the line segment joining the midpoints of two sides of a triangle
Solve problems and prove riders using parallel lines, triangles, quadrilaterals and the midpoint theorem

topics.name: Analytical Geometry
subtopics: Distance between two points
Gradient of a line segment; parallel and perpendicular lines
Coordinates of the midpoint of a line segment
Represent quadrilaterals and other figures on the Cartesian plane

topics.name: Functions (including trigonometric functions)
subtopics: Concept of a function; representations via tables, graphs, words and formulae
Point-by-point plotting of y=x², y=1/x and y=bˣ (b>0, b≠1): shape, domain, range, asymptotes, symmetry, turning points, intercepts
Effect of a and q on y=a·f(x)+q for f(x)=x, x², 1/x, bˣ
Point-by-point plotting of y=sinθ, y=cosθ, y=tanθ for θ∈[0°,360°]
Effect of a and q on y=a·sinθ+q, y=a·cosθ+q, y=a·tanθ+q
Sketch graphs, find equations of given graphs, interpret graphs

topics.name: Trigonometry (2D)
subtopics: Solve two-dimensional problems involving right-angled triangles

topics.name: Statistics
subtopics: Measures of central tendency in ungrouped data: mean, median, mode
Measures of central tendency in grouped data: mean estimate, modal interval, median interval
Dispersion: range, percentiles, quartiles, inter-quartile and semi-inter-quartile range
Five number summary and box-and-whisker diagram
Analyse and comment on context using statistical summaries and graphs
Histogram

topics.name: Probability
subtopics: Probability models: relative frequency vs theoretical probability
Venn diagrams for two events; addition rule P(A or B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A and B)
Mutually exclusive and complementary events

topics.name: Finance and growth
subtopics: Simple and compound growth formulae A=P(1+in) and A=P(1+i)ⁿ (interest, hire purchase, inflation, population growth)
Implications of fluctuating foreign exchange rates

topics.name: Measurement
subtopics: Revise volume and surface area of right prisms and cylinders
Effect on volume and surface area of multiplying any dimension by a constant factor k
Volume and surface area of spheres, right pyramids, right cones and combinations of these objects

topics.name: Number patterns
subtopics: Investigate linear number patterns (constant difference between consecutive terms); general term
